learning_outcomes.text: knows the principles of data traffic modelling in different timescales
can apply Markov processes to model the traffic process of simple communications and IT systems
can analyze these models to evaluate the performance
can define and apply the basic concepts in information theory (entropy, etc.)
can distinguish between lossless and lossy data compression and can describe different compression methods
can calculate the capacity of a simple communications channel

syllabus_topics: Introduction to stochastic processes and the Poisson process
Discrete-state and continuous-time Markov processes and discrete-time Markov chains
Data traffic modeling in different time scales and different traffic types
Various queuing systems and their application to performance evaluation
Information theory and its significance in information technology
Forms of entropy and their relationship to channel and source coding
Capacities of discrete-time, continuous-time and multiuser channels
